program.name: Calm Express
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: A short calm session with no gear: Pilates or core, a slow bodyweight circuit, then yin.
program.about: Calm strength in under half an hour, no gear. A short Pilates series or core circuit, a slow circuit of push-ups, squats and bridges, then one or two long yin holds. A good way to close a busy day. Level II slows every rep down and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Pilates, slow bodyweight circuit & yin / core, slow bodyweight circuit & yin, short
